items.title: OAuth / real role gates
items.detail: 2.0 now uses Google Identity Services sign-in, ignores stale local viewer fixtures, enforces the allowlist, gives all allowlisted users shared app/admin/client controls, and keeps full payout dropdown / payout ledger access limited to the configured full-payout email set. Deployed URL origins must still match the Google OAuth web client.

items.title: External calendar-feed appointment matching
items.detail: 2.0 now pulls action=calendarfeed, parses ICS events, matches calendar entries to Sheet events, and shows calendar-derived Next/Last appointment footer values. Event ledger card order is intentionally driven by Sheet event date/start time, not calendar appointment date.

items.title: Live payout override source
items.detail: Payouts still use schedule fallback because the current 2.0 Apps Script source does not expose the legacy staff payout tabs. This is the biggest accounting/source-of-truth gap.

items.title: Actual Drive art upload
items.detail: 2.0 can save an uploaded art URL, but it does not yet upload a file to Drive like the Expo app did.

items.title: Audit/activity log
items.detail: Admin Audit Log page is rebuilt against the Sheet-backed Audit Log tab, and the current Apps Script source already writes internal audit rows for event upserts/deletes/generator link updates. 2.0 also includes explicit viewer-stamped audit calls for saves/deletes/generates, but the GET appendaudit Apps Script handler must be deployed by the script owner/domain account before those extra viewer payload rows work on the live /exec URL. Notes can append communication blocks, but full Expo activity-log delete/Discord behavior is not rebuilt.

items.title: Staff assignment live artist source
items.detail: 2.0 now pulls the live Staff Directory from Apps Script, uses active Sheet rows for Staff Assignment artist/counter chip options, applies ED Entry / alias normalization, and uses live Color Hex values for staff chip/card colors. Local constants remain as fallback if the endpoint is unavailable.

items.title: Production mutation testing
items.detail: Save/delete/generate/new/overwrite are wired, but we have not deliberately tested them on a safe production row. Until then, those should stay partial.
